# JSTOR Daily

> > JSTOR Daily brings scholarship to life by contextualizing current events, trends, and cultural phenomena through peer-reviewed research and academic perspectives.

JSTOR Daily is a digital magazine published by ITHAKA that bridges the gap between scholarly research and public understanding. The publication covers viral internet trends, memes, cultural movements, and contemporary topics by drawing connections to academic literature and historical context.

## Key Topics

- Scholarly content and academic publishing
- Digital library and educational resources
- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Internet memes and exploitable formats
- Know Your Meme cultural documentation
- JSTOR and ITHAKA services
- Open access and nonprofit publishing
- Social media phenomena (Twitter/X, Facebook)
- Nostalgia and cultural memory
- Scientific American partnerships
- Contemporary catchphrases and language
- Image macros and visual culture
- Subscription and access models

## About & Mission

- [About JSTOR Daily](https://daily.jstor.org/about): Learn about JSTOR Daily's mission to contextualize current events and cultural phenomena through scholarly research and academic perspectives
